items.title: World's tallest timber tower tops out in Sydney
items.summary: The Atlassian Central skyscraper, designed by SHoP Architects and BVN Architecture, in Sydney, Australia, has become the world's tallest hybrid timber tower. Designed as the Sydney headquarters for technology company Atlassian, the 180-metre-high office tower topped out earlier this week.
